name: SkyGuard
author: mvgoodwin78
description: Blacks out moving-head light output when aircraft are within a set radius, using a local ADS-B receiver or online flight data. If you use online data, your show's location and search radius go to the provider you choose (opendata.adsb.fi or api.adsb.lol). For personal use only: it does nothing until you confirm that. A typed address goes to nominatim.openstreetmap.org only when you press Look up. While its map is open, your browser loads map images from tile.openstreetmap.org, unless you clear the map address.

privacy.summary: Blacks out moving heads when aircraft are near. Can send your location to flight data and elevation services, and a typed address to OpenStreetMap. Your browser loads OpenStreetMap map images.

privacy.other: For personal use only; it does nothing until you confirm that. Runs a background program while FPP runs, and forces the dimmer and shutter channels you list to their off values during a blackout. Anyone who can reach FPP can read this plugin's status, including your show's location, can change its settings including the saved location and fixture list, can ask it to test a receiver or online provider or look up an address, and can run its Enable, Disable, Test Trigger, Test Message and Stop Test Message commands. Uninstalling removes its saved data.
